events.verdict: Trier (NYK) makes contact with Beal's (WAS) arm that affects his jump shot attempt.
Dekker (WAS) maintains legal guarding position and contact with Vonleh's (NYK) off-arm that does not affect his post move and shot attempt.
Dekker (WAS) makes marginal contact with Knox's (NYK) during the pick.
Porter Jr. (WAS) establishes legal position in Hardaway Jr.'s (NYK) path during the pick and does not deliver contact.
Beal (WAS) takes an additional dribble after having picked up his dribble.
Beal (WAS) is in the paint for more then three seconds without actively guarding an opponent.
Porter Jr. (WAS) maintains legal guarding position on Vonleh (NYK) and cleanly deflects the ball.
Randle (WAS) establishes legal position in Vonleh's (NYK) path during the screen and give him enough room to avoid contact.
Vonleh (NYK) obtains a legal guarding position and jumps vertically as he contests Ariza's (WAS) driving shot attempt.
Bryant (WAS) maintains legal guarding position and makes incidental contact with Vonleh's (NYK) arm that does not affect his post move and shot attempt.
Bryant (WAS) sets the pick on Hardaway Jr. (NYK) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Hardaway Jr. (NYK) briefly grasps Bryant's (WAS) leg during the pick but it does not affect his FOM.
Vonleh (NYK) sets the pick on Randle (WAS) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Randle (WAS) maintains legal guarding position during Mudiay's (NYK) drive attempt and Mudiay trips on his own.
Correctly called 24 second violation.
Bryant (WAS) establishes legal position in Hardaway Jr.'s (NYK) path and he does not deliver contact.
Bryant (WAS) firms up his position when he sets the screen on Trier (NYK) and he does not deliver contact.
From the camera angle available, there is no conclusive video evidence that shows if Beal (WAS) moves his pivot foot.
Beal (WAS) engages with Mudiay (NYK) in the lane but it does not affect his FOM.
Beal (WAS) makes incidental contact with Mudiay (NYK) that does not affect his jump shot attempt.
Trier (NYK) makes contact with the ball after it has reached its apex and is on its downward flight toward the basket.
